close_reason: NOT A BUG: RFC 8620 §5.4 is the copy method spec. Citation is correct.
description: email.rs:1162: comment reads '// RFC 8620 §5.4: fromAccountId MUST differ from accountId'. RFC 8620 §5.4 is the /set method spec and says nothing about copy operations. The copy spec is RFC 8620 §6.3. A contributor verifying the restriction against the RFC will not find it at §5.4. The comment should either cite §6.3 with the actual text that (arguably) implies cross-account, or be removed if the restriction is not supported by the RFC.
title: handle_email_copy comment cites RFC 8620 §5.4 for fromAccountId restriction
